submission.comment: Found an RSI mean-reversion strategy with period=22, lower threshold=20, upper threshold=70 that achieves an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.285. The strategy has low volatility (15.2%), modest max drawdown (13.7%), and low turnover (5.4% daily). It's only in the market 6.9% of the time, taking positions only when RSI reaches extreme levels. This outperforms all other strategy families tested (momentum, ma_crossover, mean_reversion, breakout).
